state.title: CHSH Game Reductions
state.description:
Final Report for graduate student project in CMSC858F at University of Maryland, College Park. The paper covers 2-player non-local games, their lower bounds, and their reductions to single-player cryptographic protocols.

About CMSC858F: Algorithmic Lower Bounds (Fun with Hardness Proofs) is an algorithms course co-taught by Prof. Mohammad Hajiaghayi at University of Maryland and Prof. Erik Demaine at College Park.
